examples.label: Example 1
examples.input:
8
new 2
book 0 10
book 5 8
book 9 12
book 6 9
cancel 0 0
book 6 9
cancel 1 7
examples.display:
calls   = RoomBooker(2), book(0, 10), book(5, 8), book(9, 12),
          book(6, 9), cancel(0, 0), book(6, 9), cancel(1, 7)
results = null, 0, 1, 1, -1, true, 0, false

Room 1 is free again from 8, so [9, 12) fits there. [6, 9) fits nowhere until the long booking in room 0 is cancelled. Room 1 has no booking that starts at 7.

examples.label: Example 2
examples.display:
calls   = RoomBooker(1), book(3, 5), book(5, 7), book(4, 6)
results = null, 0, 0, -1

[5, 7) starts as [3, 5) ends, so they share the room. [4, 6) overlaps both.
